styling.notes: @nimiq/style + nq-* component classes; vanilla PWA assets in public/

settlement.notes: src/nimiq/cashlink.ts mints a Cashlink per chore payout; src/nimiq/client.ts SIM flag (NIMIQ_SIM) runs the full UX with no faucet/network. Live testnet needs a funded DEV_PARENT_PRIV.

edge.notes: Cloudflare DNS+proxy in front of <app>.fly.dev for TLS/DDoS/WAF; enable Access for internal-only apps. Deploy is gated on the CI workflow via workflow_run(CI) so a red check/test/file-size guard blocks the deploy.
